name: Heat-set inserts
description: Based on CNC Kitchen's heat-set inserts. Select sketch points or circles: each gets the hole for an insert, and the insert.

size.title: Size
size.description: A CNC Kitchen insert: the screw thread and the insert length. It sets the diameter, the length and the thread together.

create.title: Create
create.description: Hole and insert drills the part under each selected point and adds the insert as a component of its own, placed on every point. Hole only drills without an insert. Both need a selected point or circle. Insert only works with or without one: with nothing selected the insert sits on the origin.

hole_type.title: Hole type
hole_type.description: Heat-set is the straight hole for melting the insert into a printed part. Glue-in is the stepped hole for resin prints, listed for 8 sizes from M2.5 to 1/4-20.

hole_depth.title: Hole depth
hole_depth.description: Blind is the insert length plus 1 mm. Through drills through the part; put the sketch on a face of the part for it.

hole_adjust.title: Hole adjustment
hole_adjust.description: Added to the hole diameter. Printed holes come out small: raise this in 0.1 mm steps until the insert fits your printer.

custom_diameter.title: Custom diameter
custom_diameter.description: Optional. Outside diameter across the knurl points. Leave empty for the diameter of the chosen Size.

custom_length.title: Custom length
custom_length.description: Optional. Overall length of the insert. Leave empty for the length of the chosen Size.

custom_thread.title: Custom thread
custom_thread.description: Optional. A screw size for the bore that replaces the thread of the chosen Size, such as M8x1. The insert has to be larger than this thread.

thread_modeled.title: Modeled thread
thread_modeled.description: Cut the internal thread. Off leaves a cosmetic thread, which rebuilds faster. Unified and pipe sizes stay cosmetic.

sketch.title: Sketch
sketch.description: Optional. Leave empty to use the point or circle you selected before opening this. To place by name instead, type the sketch name here and fill in Sketch point.

sketch_point.title: Sketch point
sketch_point.description: Optional. The id of a point or circle in that sketch, such as c1 or c1.center. Leave empty to use the selection.
